high_level_description: The image is a promotional poster for films that are recommended for architects. The background is a plain, light gray color, which contrasts with the bold red text at the top of the poster. The text reads: "IF YOU'RE INTERESTED IN ARCHITECTURE, YOU SHOULD DEFINITELY SEE THESE FILMS." Below this, in larger, even more prominent red text, it says: "FILMS YOU SHOULDN'T MISS AS AN ARCHITECT." The central part of the image features three individuals dressed in formal attire, standing against a vibrant red door. The person on the left is wearing a purple uniform
